{"notes": "VISIT 3 (6:30-7:15). Still can't tell who placed what, so ratings stay provisional. The table is no better: the dark chain runs from the start down the diagonal, along the bottom body and around the tail loop. The top body arc is still pale and the nose stub above the head is still pale. Only about half falls.

MAYA: Candid, and her public and private reports matched. But 'the fish shape is all there' overstates it, because the top body is the main gap and she owns it. She is still bridging from higher up the dark line, and the 7:00 inspection is diagnosis, not a fix. She keeps Leo and Tom out of her corner while it's the bottleneck, and she still hasn't delegated the top line. Leadership and impact are weak, and she is the main risk to the result. Ask at the review why she didn't hand off the top line.

TOM: Told me privately he'd close the nose join. Priya then took it and told him to move to the junction. He was quiet this visit, so I can't tell whether he switched, and the nose is still open. Earlier reliable reporting counts in his favour. Confirm what he did after 6:45.

PRIYA: Spoke up for the first time and was specific. She located the stub, took the nose join and redirected Tom, which is good collaboration and initiative. But the join hasn't closed yet. Rate her on whether it connects. This partly answers my earlier question.

LEO: Silent this visit, with no new evidence. His last reports were reliable, but his impact is unclear. Ask what he did in this window and why he wasn't used on the top body."}
